item.title: Biology is a Burrito: A text- and visual-based journey through a living cell
item.description:
📝 All the biochemicals are pushed together, bumping into each other. But with numbers, living cells come alive. A microbe's guts are a veritable Times Square, crowded with sugars, proteins, and water molecules that ricochet and smash into each other billions of times each second.
🔗 Read more: https://burrito.bio/essays/biology-is-a-burrito

item.title: Copy Fail: 732 Bytes to Root on Every Major Linux Distribution
item.description:
